confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures (MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan) and a 2023 Delhi chain cappuccino survey, so restaurant and coffee values are medium-to-low confidence. Beer, cocktail and wine are mostly inferred from Delhi, Bengaluru and Mumbai data plus the local beer-to-cocktail and beer-to-wine relationship, not Varanasi observations. Alcohol is restricted or unavailable at many Varanasi venues, so the drink anchors may not represent typical local pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no accommodation searches or live listings were consulted. The FX observation was taken from RBA search-result text for 2026-10-16 (0.6947 USD per AUD), not from a page read; the same result reported 0.6955 for 2026-10-15, so verify on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is South Asian mid-sized tourist cities, with prices set below Delhi. MyLifeElsewhere estimates Varanasi restaurant prices about 37% and overall costs about 35% below Delhi. Accommodation is set against guesthouse and hostel norms in Indian pilgrimage and tourist cities.
